raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
> (auto generated by Claude)

#47173 changed `EAGLEDraftExtendCudaGraphRunner._cache_loc_dtype()` from `torch.int64` to `self.backend.cache_loc_dtype`. `test_inkling_checkpoint_indices.py` builds that runner with `resolve_decode_backend` patched to a bare `Mock()`, so the dtype is now a `Mock` and the test fails on main with `TypeError: ones(): argument 'dtype' must be torch.dtype, not Mock`. Since it is a `base-b-kernel-unit` 1-gpu-large test, `jit-kernel-unit-test-1-gpu-large` fails for every PR.

The mocked backend now carries `cache_loc_dtype=torch.int64`, the value the runner used before #47173.

Validation: `/rerun-test` of the file on CI.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

<!-- pr-check-comment runs=41403621074 -->
Required checks failed on c3287ed; this PR cannot be merged until they pass.

**Lint** ([run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41403621074))
Run `pre-commit run --all-files` locally and push the result. The run log shows any other failing step.

Additional CI evidence from #43786 confirming the same fixture failure.

- PR head: `fb4e80ea8474e8fdb7aab692119202f4834a424c`.
- Actual CI checkout: merge `5da168b82470b256b49f494dc27ceb991c4399c1`, with upstream main parent `1599b166ac856f4fd192feb2c16304fae7860a72`.
- [Failing NVIDIA job: `jit-kernel-unit-test-1-gpu-large (0)`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41413851551/job/125186911609).

The failure is in `TestInklingCheckpointIndices.test_draft_runners_capture_and_replay_checkpoint_destinations` with `(multilayer=False, static=False, tracking=False)`:

```text
test_inkling_checkpoint_indices.py:763
    return eagle.EAGLEDraftExtendCudaGraphRunner(worker).buffers
eagle_draft_extend_cuda_graph_runner.py:172
    out_cache_loc = torch.ones(..., dtype=self._cache_loc_dtype())
TypeError: ones(): argument 'dtype' must be torch.dtype, not Mock
```

I compared the actual CI merge with its upstream main parent. Both files have identical blob SHAs on the two revisions, and neither is modified by #43786:

| File | Matching blob SHA |
| --- | --- |
| `test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_inkling_checkpoint_indices.py` | `4710016ace05091fe7a77566cf52c7ae08ed07d3` |
| `python/sglang/srt/speculative/eagle_draft_extend_cuda_graph_runner.py` | `bb3a791c0962efa6a38f23fc538808a8fc3f449a` |

The fixture's `resolve_decode_backend` returns a bare `Mock()`, so the `Mock(cache_loc_dtype=torch.int64)` change here directly addresses the observed dtype error.

This also caused four subsequent Base GPU jobs to stop at `check-pr-test-health` fail-fast rather than execute their tests; [`wait-for-base-b`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41413851551/job/125191450975) then failed as a consequence. Separately, #43786's [B200 wo_a quantization test file](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41413851551/job/125186911527) passed all 7 tests, including its new numerical-equivalence and CUDA Graph tests.

Sharing this as another affected PR and a concrete reproduction of the baseline blocker. Thanks for the fix!

                 "require_mlp_tp_gather": False,
